# Lansweeper

> Lansweeper is an IT asset discovery and management platform providing comprehensive documentation, real-time service monitoring, and API-driven automation capabilities.

Lansweeper offers a cloud-based platform for network discovery, asset management, and IT operations. The site provides extensive documentation through its Knowledge Center and maintains transparent service status reporting for platform reliability.

## Key Topics

- Lansweeper Platform
- Network Discovery
- Asset Management
- Public API
- Cloud Infrastructure
- SSO/MFA Authentication
- Webhooks
- Agent Technology
- Asset Radar
- Lansweeper Classic
- Service Health Monitoring
- IT Operations
- Platform Navigation
- Documentation Hub
- Incident Management

## Documentation & Learning

- [Lansweeper Knowledge Center](https://docs.lansweeper.com/): Comprehensive documentation hub providing guides for platform navigation, features, and best practices for using the Lansweeper platform

## Service Status & Support

- [Lansweeper Status](https://status.lansweeper.com/): Real-time service status dashboard and incident history for all Lansweeper platform components with uptime monitoring and operational updates
